crossRefs.note: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.
Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall…
Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and…
All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.
translations.bsb: The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
